name: core-approvals
description: Approvals, the core's sign-offs on the moves of the type's Workflow (D56): the gate on a transition, signOff with its permission and its vetoes, withdrawSignOff, the creator's exclusion and from, the Approvals.gates field and its events, what consumes a sign-off (a change of the own fields, an update's or an operation's update(), and entering the gated state, whoever moves it), listSignOffs, its config, its rule for a new version, deletes and its guidance. Lease beside it is in the work-queue package's lease-approvals test.
